headline: Unbeaten Davis & Elkins take over at the top
dek: Davis & Elkins beat West Virginia Wesleyan to move a point clear of Charleston at the top of the table, and remain the only side in the conference without a defeat, with seven wins and a draw from eight matches. Charleston have won every conference match they have played, but were beaten at home in August.
displaced_by: Davis & Elkins go top of the table after beating West Virginia Wesleyan; the standing dek's line that Charleston sit above them is no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than Point Park, Salem and West Virginia Wesleyan together, and twelve different players have shared their twenty-seven; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Charleston scored ten in a single match against West Virginia Wesleyan, more than Wesleyan have scored all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Davis & Elkins have won seven of their eight matches and conceded six goals in them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Charleston have won seven of their eight matches, scoring twenty-seven goals and conceding six.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win after eight matches, with one draw and seven defeats, and have conceded thirty goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has six goals and three assists for Frostburg State from nineteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Floyd Watts has made forty saves in Shawnee State's goal and been beaten fourteen times.

last_match.line: Davis & Elkins are still the only side without a defeat and now lead the table; West Virginia Wesleyan have lost every conference match they have played.

next_match.line: Concord arrive on the back of consecutive conference clean sheets; Wheeling have yet to take a point in conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
